question: The main purpose of skin preparation before surgery is to:

question: A woman has had a right mastectomy with axillary node clearance. On which side should the nurse avoid blood pressure measurement and venepuncture?

✅ Correct Answer: c. vitamin D

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Vitamin D is needed for calcium absorption and bone mineralisation, so its deficiency causes rickets

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — vitamin K: Vitamin K deficiency causes bleeding

B — vitamin A: Vitamin A deficiency causes night blindness

D — vitamin C: Vitamin C deficiency causes scurvy

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: Sunlight helps the skin make vitamin D

question: The change of a liquid into vapour at its boiling point is called:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. boiling

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Boiling is the rapid change of a liquid into vapour that occurs at the boiling point

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — condensation: Condensation is vapour changing into liquid

C — filtration: Filtration separates solids from liquids

D — sublimation: Sublimation is solid changing directly into gas

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: Boiling is used to sterilise some heat-resistant items and to make water safe

question: Which of the following is a compound?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. water

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen chemically combined, so it is a compound

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — gold: Gold is an element

B — oxygen: Oxygen is an element

C — nitrogen: Nitrogen is an element

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: Compounds have fixed proportions of their elements

question: The refractive index of a medium is the ratio of the speed of light in vacuum to:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. the speed of light in the medium

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Refractive index compares the speed of light in vacuum with its speed in the given medium

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — its density: Density is not part of the definition

B — its frequency: Frequency stays constant in different media

C — its wavelength: Wavelength changes with the medium but is not the definition

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: A higher refractive index means light slows more and bends more
option_4: the speed of light in the medium

question: Which blood group is called the universal recipient for red cell transfusion?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. AB positive

🧠 Clinical Rationale: AB positive blood has both A and B antigens and the Rh antigen, so it can receive red cells from any group

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — B negative: B negative can receive only limited groups

C — O negative: O negative is the universal donor

D — A positive: A positive can receive only limited groups

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: Cross-matching is still done before transfusion

question: What is 50% of 360?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. 180

🧠 Method: Fifty per cent is half, and half of 360 is 180

⚡ Fast Approach: Break the percentage into easy parts (10 percent, 5 percent, 1 percent) and add them.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 120: 120 is one-third of 360

B — 160: 160 is less than half

C — 200: 200 is more than half

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: A percentage is simply a fraction of 100

question: The average of 20, 30 and 40 is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. 30

🧠 Method: The sum is 90 and there are three numbers, so the average is 30

⚡ Fast Approach: Total = average x number of items. Find the total first, then subtract the known values.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 35: 35 is above the middle value

C — 90: 90 is the sum, not the average

D — 25: 25 is below the middle value

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Average equals the sum divided by the count

question: If a : b = 2 : 3 and b = 12, what is the value of a?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. 8

🧠 Method: Since b is 12 and the ratio term is 3, one part is 4, so a = 2 × 4 = 8

⚡ Fast Approach: Add the parts to get the total number of parts, then find the value of one part.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 9: 9 would make the ratio 3 : 4

B — 6: 6 would make the ratio 1 : 2

C — 18: 18 is the value of b plus a part

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Trick: Find the value of one part from the known term

question: ₹500 is divided between two people in the ratio 1 : 4. What is the smaller share?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. ₹100

🧠 Method: The parts total 5, so one part is ₹100 and the smaller share is ₹100

⚡ Fast Approach: Add the parts to get the total number of parts, then find the value of one part.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — ₹400: ₹400 is the larger share

B — ₹125: ₹125 is not a whole part

D — ₹200: ₹200 is two parts

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Trick: Add the ratio terms to find the value of one part

question: A machine produces 240 items in 8 hours. How many items will it produce in 5 hours at the same rate?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. 150

🧠 Method: The rate is 30 items per hour, so in 5 hours the machine makes 150 items

⚡ Fast Approach: Write down what is given and what is asked before calculating.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 180: 180 items would take 6 hours

B — 200: 200 items would take about 6.7 hours

D — 120: 120 items would take 4 hours

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Trick: Find the rate for one hour first, then multiply

question: The simple interest on ₹1,200 at 5% per annum for 3 years is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. ₹180

🧠 Method: Simple interest is principal × rate × time ÷ 100, so 1,200 × 5 × 3 ÷ 100 = ₹180

⚡ Fast Approach: SI = P x R x T / 100. Keep T in years - convert months to a fraction.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — ₹200: ₹200 does not follow the formula

B — ₹210: ₹210 would need a higher rate

D — ₹150: ₹150 is the interest for 2.5 years

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Trick: Simple interest is charged on the original principal only

question: A car covers 120 km at 60 km/h and returns over the same distance at 40 km/h. What is its average speed for the whole journey?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. 48 km/h

🧠 Method: Total distance is 240 km, total time is 2 + 3 = 5 hours, so the average speed is 48 km/h

⚡ Fast Approach: Average speed = total distance / total time - never the mean of the two speeds.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 52 km/h: 52 km/h is too high

C — 50 km/h: 50 km/h is the simple average of the two speeds, which is wrong

D — 45 km/h: 45 km/h does not follow the time

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: For a return journey, average speed is total distance divided by total time

question: Find the next number: 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, __
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. 16

🧠 Method: The differences are 1, 2, 3, 4, so the next difference is 5 and the term is 16

⚡ Fast Approach: Check the differences first, then squares, cubes or multiplication.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 15: 15 ignores the increasing step

B — 17: 17 skips a value

D — 14: 14 suits a step of 3

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Check whether the difference between terms itself increases steadily

question: Which one is different from the others: apple, banana, potato, mango?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. potato

🧠 Method: Potato is a vegetable, while the others are fruits

⚡ Fast Approach: Draw the circles of the given sets and see which conclusion is certain.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — mango: Mango is a fruit

C — apple: Apple is a fruit

D — banana: Banana is a fruit

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

question: If MOON is written as NPPM in a code, how is STAR written in the same code?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. TUBS

🧠 Method: Each letter moves one step forward, so S→T, T→U, A→B, R→S, giving TUBS

⚡ Fast Approach: Compare the first and last letters of the given pair to find the shift.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — TTBS: The second letter is not shifted

C — STBS: The first letter is not shifted

D — TURS: The third letter is not shifted

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Trick: Apply the same shift to every letter

question: A man walks 3 km north, then 4 km west, then 3 km south. How far is he from the starting point?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. 4 km

🧠 Method: The north and south legs cancel, leaving only the 4 km westward move, so he is 4 km from the start

⚡ Fast Approach: Draw a small diagram - each turn changes the direction by a fixed angle.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 5 km: 5 km would apply if the path formed a right angle

B — 3 km: 3 km is one of the legs

C — 7 km: 7 km wrongly adds the distances

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Offsetting movements in opposite directions cancel each other

question: Pointing to a boy, a woman says, "He is the son of my father's only son." How is the boy related to the woman?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. nephew

🧠 Method: The woman's father's only son is her brother, so the boy is her brother's son, that is her nephew

⚡ Fast Approach: Draw the family tree and mark the given relations before answering.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — son: Her own son would be described as "my son"

B — cousin: A cousin would be the child of an uncle or aunt

C — brother: A brother would be the father's son, not his son's child

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Trick: Identify each relative step by step from the speaker

question: All nurses wear uniforms. Some uniform-wearers are doctors. Which conclusion definitely follows?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Nothing definite can be said about nurses being doctors

🧠 Method: The doctors who wear uniforms may or may not include nurses, so nothing definite follows

⚡ Fast Approach: Draw the circles of the given sets and see which conclusion is certain.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Some nurses are doctors: This is possible but not certain

C — All doctors are nurses: This reverses the relationship

D — No nurse is a doctor: This is also not certain

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: A particular statement cannot prove a link between two groups
option_1: Nothing definite can be said about nurses being doctors

🧠 Method: Each term is the sum of the two before it, so 8 + 13 = 21

⚡ Fast Approach: Check the differences first, then squares, cubes or multiplication.
